content: Walk as if you are kissing the Earth with your feet.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sourceWork: Thich Nhat Hanh's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Thich Nhat Hanh's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of earth and nature. Across his life and work, Thich Nhat Hanh returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What lesson in endurance or renewal can you draw from the natural world today?
